infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: HearMe uses your location for emergency SMS links and live speed.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: HearMe uses your location to share it with trusted contacts during an emergency, even when the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: HearMe uses your camera to detect hidden camera IR LEDs and capture evidence.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: HearMe records audio as evidence and listens for distress sounds when voice trigger is enabled.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: HearMe imports contacts so you can quickly add trusted emergency contacts.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: HearMe uses Face ID as a quick alternative to your PIN to unlock the app.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: HearMe needs access to your photo library so you can set a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: HearMe saves captured evidence photos to your photo library when you ask it to.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: HearMe pairs with your NeuroBand to detect distress signals.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: HearMe pairs with your NeuroBand to detect distress signals.
